notes.title: “C.A.R.D.S. RPG: The Misty Battlefield” Released!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42425363/2a5d8a9d157cf8f4672103f6ffc1e9a1e43e2d54.jpg[/img]

The story of the passionate bonds and fighting spirit of the Clausewitz Battalion.  
'C.A.R.D.S. RPG: The Misty Battlefield' is now available!

In this world of SRPG that demands strategy, roguelike elements are fused together.  
Build the optimal deck from over 100 cards and strategically confront enemies on the SRPG field.  
Lead the Clausewitz Battalion, commanded by Vel Dina, to victory.

Launch sale with 10% OFF for 14 days starting from today!
